feed.title: Bizkaiko Foru Aldundia Cadastral Parcels Download Service
feed.subtitle: ATOM service for downloading predefined dataset that enables accessing, consulting and downloading products generated by the Bizkaiko Foru Aldundia. The service is in accordance with the technical specifications of INSPIRE download services (version 3.1). The products are served according to the original data model of each project. The access or connection to this service, to obtain the functionalities it is intended for, is free in all cases provided that the authorship of the Bizkaiko Foru Aldundia is mentioned as the owner of the service and of its content (which can be stored for private use) as follows: «©Bizkaiko Foru Aldundia»
